title: Second Regular Meeting August 2026
summary: The second meeting was held on 31st August 2026 after the Board meeting on 21st August 2026 to discuss main points on the Agenda and discuss Project status.
description: The second meeting was held on 31st August 2026 after the Board meeting on 21st August 2026 to discuss main points on the Agenda and discuss Project status. The Club has several big projects lined up and co-ordination was going on for its execution. The Club was also in process of setting up Installation of Rotaract Club for 2026-27 for which meetings were held with Rotaractors for readiness and implementation. The Club Rotarians had also received Awards from District for their outstanding work and contribution for Year 2025-26. The Awards were distributed to Rotarians and felicitated.
